name: Text break and slam
what: A bold line sits in the middle; a second, glowing line falls in from the top edge smeared by motion and slams onto it; the first line flashes to an accent colour and breaks into segments, the last two words slanted, and both lines bounce into place.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f10 (00:00:00:00-00:00:00:10) the first line is still; f5-f11 (00:00:00:05-00:00:00:11) the glowing line falls from above the frame in a straight 65 px-a-frame line, smeared vertically, and lands at f11 (00:00:00:11); f10-f12 (00:00:00:10-00:00:00:12) the first line turns peach then the accent colour and at f12 breaks into segments, a size smaller and lower, the last two words slanted; f12-f16 (00:00:00:12-00:00:00:16) the broken line lands high, drops below its place and bounces to rest; f12-f26 (00:00:00:12-00:00:00:26) the glowing line bounces up 51 px (f16) and back down to rest; hold to f56 (00:00:01:26)

tracks.name: glowing line falls
